keyFindings.description: CI's dispatch job 121364414957 (run 40258016033, Legion Envoy and Contracts) at code head 2451b5dcba77 failed in Firefox on 2 of the 5 new rows: :193 (11a, line 227: the Thinking level picker is still aria-disabled after the model switch was answered) and :339 (11d, line 372: the status is still 'Switching model to anthropic/model-b…' after the answer). The same rows pass in chromium, iphone and webkit, and the 3 Firefox rows that need no answer pass. Both traces (artifact dispatch-e2e-test-results-1) show the same thing: after the POST and its refetch of /agents/<id>/messages, the page never refetches the messages again, and its /api/v1/events request is opened again about 1 s after the POST and ends with status -1. So the page never sees the session's answer, and in Firefox a switch the session answered stays pending until the 30 s deadline. The plan (decision 6a, rows 11a-11d in every engine) makes these rows part of the A2 proof.
